access modifiers.description:
TS 1.0
access modifiers
`public` (default) / `protected` (visible to subclasses) / `private` (class-only) — all compile-time only, erased at emit; JS's own `#field` (see class.json) is the runtime-enforced alternative.

abstract class.description:
TS 1.6
abstract class / abstract method
An abstract class can't be instantiated directly and may declare abstract members that subclasses must implement.

definite assignment assertion.description:
TS 2.7
definite assignment assertion (`!`)
Tells the compiler a property is guaranteed to be assigned before use (e.g. by a lifecycle method), suppressing the 'property has no initializer' error.

override method.description:
TS 4.3
override
Marks a subclass method as intentionally overriding a base-class member; the compiler errors if the base member doesn't actually exist (catches typos/renames).
